title: Search finds vendors, ventures, scrip turn-ins — and every currency
blurb: The Ctrl+K search now covers every NPC with a page — gil-shop vendors, scrip and tomestone exchanges, collectable appraisers — with their zone, so "merchant limsa" and "scrip exchange" work, retainer venture rewards and crafted collectable turn-ins, each landing on the right row of the Venture Analyzer or Scrip Sources. Currencies were only half-indexed before — Wolf Marks and Fae Fancy were unfindable — and now match the Currency Exchange page exactly. Add a type word to nudge results: "iron ingot recipe" puts the recipe first.
